snippet.title: 3-D Ultra Pinball: The Lost Continent gameplay (PC Game, 1997)
snippet.description:
Gameplay for 3-D Ultra Pinball: The Lost Continent, PC game produced by Sierra in 1997: https://www.squakenet.com/game/3-d-ultra-pinball-the-lost-continent

Having a quick play of this episode of the 3D Ultra Pinball franchise. Some nice 3D elements to interact with in this 2 tables pinball game.

Played through old Windows XP real machine.
Recorded with full original sound.
